title: ITD Taking Instructions Training
quote: The ITD training session on taking instructions was both really helpful and interesting. It encouraged us to think about the ways in which we approach work and how we communicate with more senior lawyers; to highlight areas in which we would like to improve, and how to do so. Zoom worked well as a platform as we were all able to share our thoughts by writing on the screen, which ensured everyone took part. The material was delivered in an engaging way and the session was generally very enjoyable. Thank you!
author: Megan Griffin
subject: Taking Instructions
